G2501.def:
**Ἰωσήφ ** indecl.
(FlJ, Ἰώσηπος, -ου), ὁ (Heb. יוֹסֵף),
**Joseph**;
1. **the Son of Jacob**: [[Jhn.4.5|Jhn.4:5]], [[Act.7.9, 13-14; 7.18|Act.7:9, 13-14 7:18]], [[Heb.11.21-22|Heb.11:21-22]], [[Rev.7.8|Rev.7:8]].
2. In the genealogy of our Lord,
(a) **the son of Matthias**: [[Luk.3.24|Luk.3:24]]
(b) **the son Joram**: [[Luk.3.30|Luk.3:30]]
3. The husband of Mary, the Lord's mother [[Mat.1.16|Mat.1:16]] ff, [[Luk.1.27|Luk.1:27]], [[Jhn.1.46|Jhn.1:46]], al.
4. **One of the brethren of our Lord **(see: ἀδελφός): [[Mat.13.55|Mat.13:55]]
5. **Son of Mary**: [[Mat.27.56|Mat.27:56]] (-σῆς, WH, mg., RV).
6. **Joseph of Arimatbæa**: [[Mat.27.57, 59|Mat.27:57, 59]], [[Mrk.15.43, 45|Mrk.15:43, 45]], [[Luk.23.50|Luk.23:50]], [[Jhn.19.38|Jhn.19:38]].
7. see: Βαρνάβας.
8. see: Βαρσαβᾶς
(AS)

G2564.def:
**καλέω**, -ῶ,
[in LXX chiefly for קרא ;]
1. **to call, summon**: with accusative of person(s), [[Mat.20.8; 25.14|Mat.20:8 25:14]], [[Mrk.3.31|Mrk.3:31]], [[Luk.19.13|Luk.19:13]], [[Act.4.18|Act.4:18]]; before ἐκ, [[Mat.2.15|Mat.2:15]] (LXX); metaphorically, [[1Pe.2.9|1Pe.2:9]]
2. **to call to one's house, invite**: [[Luk.14.16|Luk.14:16]], [[1Co.10.27|1Co.10:27]], [[Rev.19.9|Rev.19:9]]; εἰς τ. γάμους, [[Mat.22.3|Mat.22:3]], 9 [[Luk.14.8|Luk.14:8]], 9 [[Jhn.2.2|Jhn.2:2]]; ὁ καλέσας, [[Luk.7.39|Luk.7:39]] οἱ κεκλημένοι, [[Mat.22.8|Mat.22:8]] metaphorically, of inviting to partake of the blessings of the kingdom of God (Dalman, _Words_, 118f.): [[Rom.8.30; 9.24, 25|Rom.8:30 9:24, 25]] [[1Co.7.17, 18|1Co.7:17, 18]]; before εἰς, [[1Co.1.9|1Co.1:9]], [[1Th.2.12|1Th.2:12]], [[1Ti.6.12|1Ti.6:12]]; ὁ καλῶν (καλέσας), of God, [[Gal.1.6; 5.8|Gal.1:6 5:8]], [[1Th.5.24|1Th.5:24]], [[1Pe.1.15|1Pe.1:15]], [[2Pe.1.3|2Pe.1:3]]; οἱ κεκλκλημένοι, [[Heb.9.15|Heb.9:15]] before ἐν (ἐπί), [[1Co.7.15|1Co.7:15]], [[Gal.5.13|Gal.5:13]], [[Eph.4.4|Eph.4:4]], [[1Th.4.7|1Th.4:7]]; κλήσει, [[Eph.4.1|Eph.4:1]], [[2Ti.1.9|2Ti.1:9]].
3. **to call, name call by name**: pass., [[Mat.2.23|Mat.2:23]], [[Luk.1.32|Luk.1:32]], al.; καλούμενος, [[Luk.7.11|Luk.7:11]], [[Act.7.58|Act.7:58]], al.; ὁ κ. (Deiss., _BS_, 210), [[Luk.6.15; 22.3; 23.33|Luk.6:15 22:3 23:33]], [[Act.10.1|Act.10:1]], [[Rev.12.9|Rev.12:9]], al.; with pred nom., [[Mat.5.9|Mat.5:9]], [[Luk.1.35|Luk.1:35]], [[Rom.9.26|Rom.9:26]], [[Jas.2.23|Jas.2:23]], [[1Jn.3.1|1Jn.3:1]]. (Cf. ἀντι-, ἐν-, εἰσ- (-μαι), ἐπι-, μετα-, παρα-, συν-παρα-, προ-, προσ-, συν-καλέω.)
(AS)

G2574.def:
**κάμηλος**, -ου, ὁ, ἡ
[in LXX for גָּמַל ;]
**camel**: [[Mat.3.4|Mat.3:4]], [[Mrk.1.6|Mrk.1:6]]; in proverbs, [[Mat.19.24; 23.24|Mat.19:24 23:24]], [[Mrk.10.25|Mrk.10:25]], [[Luk.18.25|Luk.18:25]] (on the seel. κάμιλος, see WH, _Notes_, 151).†
κάμιλος, see: κάμηλος, and cf. Thayer; LS, s.v
(AS)

G2570.def:
**καλός**, -ή, -όν,
[in LXX chiefly for טוֹבָה ,טוֹב, also for יָפֶה, etc. ;]
1. primarily, of outward form ("related to . . . ἀγαθός as the appearance to the essence," Cremer, 339), **fair, beautiful**: λίθοι (BV, **goodly**), [[Luk.21.5|Luk.21:5]]
2. In reference to use, of that which is well adapted to its ends, **good, excellent**: of fish, τ. καλά (opposite to σαπρά), [[Mat.13.48|Mat.13:48]] σπέρμα, [[Mat.13.24, 27, 37, 38|Mat.13:24, 27, 37, 38]]; καρπός, [[Mat.3.10; 7.17-19; 12.33|Mat.3:10 7:17-19 12:33]], [[Luk.3.9|Luk.3:9]] [WH] 6:43; δένδρον (opposite to σαρπόν), [[Mat.12.33|Mat.12:33]], [[Luk.6.43|Luk.6:43]]; γῆ, [[Mat.13.8, 23|Mat.13:8, 23]] [[Mrk.4.8, 20|Mrk.4:8, 20]] [[Luk.8.15|Luk.8:15]]; τ. ἅλας, [[Mrk.9.50|Mrk.9:50]], [[Luk.14.34|Luk.14:34]]; ὁ νόμος, [[Rom.7.16|Rom.7:16]], [[1Ti.1.8|1Ti.1:8]]; διδασκαλία, [[1Ti.4.6|1Ti.4:6]] καρδία κ. καὶ ἀγαθή, [[Luk.8.15|Luk.8:15]] παραθήκη, [[2Ti.1.14|2Ti.1:14]] μέτρον, [[Luk.6.38|Luk.6:38]] βαθμός, [[1Ti.3.13|1Ti.3:13]] θεμέλιος, [[1Ti.6.19|1Ti.6:19]] τὸ κ., [[1Th.5.21|1Th.5:21]] μαργαρίται, [[Mat.13.45|Mat.13:45]] οἶνος, [[Jhn.2.10|Jhn.2:10]] ποιμήν, [[Jhn.10.11, 14|Jhn.10:11, 14]]; διάκονος, [[1Ti.4.6|1Ti.4:6]] οἰκονόμος, [[1Pe.4.10|1Pe.4:10]] στρατιώτης, [[2Ti.2.3|2Ti.2:3]] στρατεία, [[1Ti.1.18|1Ti.1:18]] ἀγών, [[1Ti.6.12|1Ti.6:12]], [[2Ti.4.7|2Ti.4:7]]; ὁμολογία, [[1Ti.6.12, 13|1Ti.6:12, 13]]; ἔργον, [[Mat.26.10|Mat.26:10]], [[Mrk.14.6|Mrk.14:6]], [[Jhn.10.33|Jhn.10:33]], [[1Ti.3.1|1Ti.3:1]]; pl., [[Jhn.10.32|Jhn.10:32]] καλόν, with inf. and dative, [[Mat.18.8|Mat.18:8]], 9 [[1Co.7.1, 26; 9.15|1Co.7:1, 26 9:15]]; id. with accusative and inf., [[Mat.17.4|Mat.17:4]], [[Mrk.9.5, 43, 45, 47|Mrk.9:5, 43, 45, 47]], [[Luk.9.33|Luk.9:33]], [[Heb.13.9|Heb.13:9]]; before εἰ, [[Mat.26.24|Mat.26:24]], [[Mrk.9.42; 14.21|Mrk.9:42 14:21]]; ἐάν, [[1Co.7.8|1Co.7:8]]
3. Ethically, **good**, in the sense of right, **fair, noble, honourable**: [[Gal.4.18|Gal.4:18]], [[Heb.5.14|Heb.5:14]]; ἔργα, [[Mat.5.16|Mat.5:16]], [[1Ti.5.10, 25; 6.18|1Ti.5:10, 25 6:18]], [[Tit.2.7, 14; 3.8, 14|Tit.2:7, 14 3:8, 14]] (Field, _Notes_, 223f.), [[Heb.10.24|Heb.10:24]], [[1Pe.2.12|1Pe.2:12]]; ἀναστροφή, [[Jas.3.13|Jas.3:13]], [[1Pe.2.12|1Pe.2:12]]; συνείδησις, [[Heb.13.18|Heb.13:18]] before ἐνώπιον, [[Rom.12.17|Rom.12:17]], [[2Co.8.21|2Co.8:21]], [[1Ti.2.3|1Ti.2:3]]; το] κ. ποιεῖν (κατεργάζεσθαι), [[Rom.7.18, 21|Rom.7:18, 21]] [[2Co.13.7|2Co.13:7]], [[Gal.6.9|Gal.6:9]], [[Jas.4.17|Jas.4:17]]; καλόν ἐστιν, with inf., [[Mat.15.26|Mat.15:26]] (T, ἔξεστιν), [[Mrk.7.27|Mrk.7:27]], [[Rom.14.21|Rom.14:21]], [[Gal.4.18|Gal.4:18]]; μαρτυρία, [[1Ti.3.7|1Ti.3:7]] ὄνομα, [[Jas.2.7|Jas.2:7]] καύχημα, [[1Co.5.6|1Co.5:6]] (neg.); θεοῦ ῥῆμα, [[Heb.6.5|Heb.6:5]] κ. does not occur in Re.†
_SYN._: see: ἀγαθός. (AS)

G2584.def:
**καφαρναούμ** (Καπερ-, Rec., see WH, _App._ 160), ἡ (Heb. נַחוּם כָּפָר Nahum's village)
**Capernaum**: [[Mat.4.13|Mat.4:13]], [[Mrk.1.21|Mrk.1:21]], [[Jhn.2.12|Jhn.2:12]], al
(AS)

G2521.def:
**κάθ-ημαι **
[in LXX chiefly for יָשַׁב ;]
in cl. present and imperfect only (prop. pf. and plpf. of καθέζομαι; cf. Bl., § 24), in LXX and NT fut. also, **to sit, be seated**: [[Mat.11.16; 22.44|Mat.11:16 22:44]]" (LXX), [[Mrk.2.6|Mrk.2:6]], [[Jhn.6.3|Jhn.6:3]], [[Act.2.2|Act.2:2]], [[Jas.2.3|Jas.2:3]] (on the vulgar imper. κάθου, see Kennedy, _Sources_, 162), [[Rev.4.3|Rev.4:3]], al.; before prep. with accusative, ἐπί, [[Mat.9.9|Mat.9:9]], [[Mrk.2.14|Mrk.2:14]], [[Jhn.12.16|Jhn.12:16]]; παρά, [[Mat.13.1|Mat.13:1]], [[Mrk.10.46|Mrk.10:46]]; περί, [[Mrk.3.32, 34|Mrk.3:32, 34]]; πρός, [[Luk.22.56|Luk.22:56]] ὑπό, [[Jas.2.3|Jas.2:3]] εἰς, [[Mrk.13.3|Mrk.13:3]] μετά, with genitive of person(s), [[Mat.26.58|Mat.26:58]] ἐκ δεξιῶν, [[Mat.22.44|Mat.22:44]] ἐπάνω, with genitive, [[Mat.28.2|Mat.28:2]] ἀπέναντι, with genitive, [[Mat.27.61|Mat.27:61]] ἐπί, with dative, [[Act.3.10|Act.3:10]] id. with genitive, [[Act.8.28|Act.8:28]] ἐκεῖ, [[Mat.15.29|Mat.15:29]] pleonastic (M, _Pr._, 230, 241; Dalman, _Words_, 22), [[Mat.13.2|Mat.13:2]], [[Act.23.3|Act.23:3]], [[Rev.18.7|Rev.18:7]]; metaphorically, [[Mat.4.16|Mat.4:16]], [[Luk.1.79|Luk.1:79]]" (LXX) ; of one's domicile ([[Neh.11.6|Neh.11:6]], [[Sir.50.26|Sir.50:26]]; Hdt., v, 63), [[Luk.21.31|Luk.21:31]], [[Act.2.2|Act.2:2]], [[Rev.14.6|Rev.14:6]] (cf. συν-κάθημαι)
(AS)

G2560.def:
**κακῶς**
(κακός),
_adv._, [in LXX: [[Wis.18.19|Wis.18:19]], [[4Ma.6.17|4Ma.6:17]]al.; κ. εἰπεῖν, ἐρεῖν (אָרַר, קָלַל pi.), [[Exo.22.28|Exo.22:28]] (27), [[Lev.19.14|Lev.19:14]], [[Isa.8.21|Isa.8:21]]; κ. ἔχειν (חָלָה, [[Ezk.34.4|Eze.34:4]], al. ;]
**badly, ill**;
(a) **in physical sense**: κ. ἔχειν, to be ill, [[Mat.4.24; 8.16; 9.12; 14.35; 17.15|Mat.4:24 8:16 9:12 14:35 17:15]], [[Mrk.1.32, 34; 2.17; 6.55; 5.31; 7.2|Mrk.1:32, 34 2:17 6:55 5:31 7:2]]; πάσχειν, [[Mat.17.15|Mat.17:15]] (WH, mg.); δαιμονίζεσθαι, [[Mat.15.22|Mat.15:22]] κακοὺς κ. ἀπολέσει (as frequently in cl., see LS, see word; MM, _Exp._, xv), evil that they are, he will evilly, etc., [[Mat.21.41|Mat.21:41]]
(b) in moral sense, wrongly ([[1Ma.7.42|1Ma.7:42]], 4Mac, l.with, al.): κ. λαλεῖν, [[Jhn.18.23|Jhn.18:23]] είπεῖν, with accusative of person(s), [[Act.23.5|Act.23:5]] αἰτεῖσθαι, [[Jas.4.8|Jas.4:8]],†
(AS)

G2523.def:
**καθ-ίζω **
[in LXX chiefly for יָשַׁב ;]
1. causal, **to make to sit down, set, appoint**: [[Act.2.30|Act.2:30]], [[1Co.6.4|1Co.6:4]], [[Eph.1.20|Eph.1:20]].
2. Intrans., **to sit down, be seated, sit**: [[Mat.5.1|Mat.5:1]], [[Mrk.9.35|Mrk.9:35]], [[Luk.7.15|Luk.7:15]], [[Jhn.8.2|Jhn.8:2]], al.; with inf. tel., [[1Co.10.7|1Co.10:7]] before εἰς, [[2Th.2.4|2Th.2:4]] ἐπί, with accusative, [[Mrk.11.2|Mrk.11:2]], [[Jhn.12.14|Jhn.12:14]]; id. with genitive, [[Jhn.19.13|Jhn.19:13]], [[Act.12.21|Act.12:21]]; ὧδε, [[Mrk.14.32|Mrk.14:32]] αὐτοῦ, [[Mat.26.36|Mat.26:36]] ἐν δεξιᾷ, [[Heb.1.3|Heb.1:3]] ἐκ δεξιῶν, [[Mat.20.21, 23|Mat.20:21, 23]]; ἐν, [[Rev.3.21|Rev.3:21]] καθίσας pleonastic (M, [[Pro.14.1-35;|Pro.14:1-35]] Dalman, _Words_, 22), [[Mat.13.48|Mat.13:48]], [[Luk.5.3; 14.31; 16.6|Luk.5:3 14:31 16:6]]; of settling in a place (ἐς χωρίον, Thuc., iv, 93), before ἐν, [[Luk.24.49|Luk.24:49]] (cf. ἀνα-, ἐπι-, παρα-, περι-, συν-καθίζω)
(AS)

G2513.def:
**καθαρός**, -ά, -όν
[in LXX chiefly for טָהוֹר ;]
pure, clean.
1. **Physically**: [[Mat.23.26; 27.59|Mat.23:26 27:59]], [[Jhn.13.10-11|Jhn.13:10-11]] (fig.), [[Jhn.15.3|Jhn.15:3]] (figuratively, as of a vine cleansed by pruning), [[Heb.10.22|Heb.10:22]], [[Rev.15.6; 19.8, 14; 21.18, 21|Rev.15:6 19:8, 14 21:18, 21]].
2. **Ceremonially**: [[Luk.11.41|Luk.11:41]], [[Rom.14.20|Rom.14:20]], [[Tit.1.15|Tit.1:15]].
3. **Ethically**;
(a) **of persons**: [[Jhn.13.16|Jhn.13:16]], [[Act.18.6|Act.18:6]], [[Tit.1.15|Tit.1:15]]; ό κ. τῇ καρδίᾳ (καθαρὸς χεῖρας, Hdt., i, 35), [[Mat.5.8|Mat.5:8]] before ἀπό (cl. with genitive simp.; ΒΙ., § 36, 11; Deiss., BS, 196; MM, _Exp._, xv), [[Act.20.26|Act.20:26]]
(b) **of things**: καρδία, [[1Ti.1.6|1Ti.1:6]], [[2Ti.2.22|2Ti.2:22]]; συνείδησις, [[1Ti.3.9|1Ti.3:9]], [[2Ti.1.3|2Ti.1:3]]; θρησκεία, [[Jas.1.27|Jas.1:27]]†
_SYN._: see: ἁγνός. (AS)

G2588.def:
**καρδία**, -ας, ἡ,
[in LXX chiefly for לֵבָב ,לֵב ;]
**the heart**,
1. the bodily organ which is regarded as the seat of life ( [[2Ki.18.14|2Ki.18:14]], [[2Ki.9.24|4Ki.9:24]], al.).
2. In a psychological sense, the seat of man's collective energies, the focus of personal life, the seat of the rational as well as the emotional and volitional elements in human life, hence that wherein lies the moral and religious condition of the man (_DB_, ii, 317f.; _DGG_, ii, 344a);
(a) of the seat of physical life ( [[Jdg.19.5|Jdg.19:5]], Psa.101 (102):5 103 (104):15): [[Act.14.17|Act.14:17]], [[Jas.5.5|Jas.5:5]];
(b) **of the seat of spiritual life**: [[Mat.5.8|Mat.5:8]], [[Mrk.7.19|Mrk.7:19]], [[Luk.1.51|Luk.1:51]], [[Act.5.3|Act.5:3]], [[Rom.10.9, 10|Rom.10:9, 10]] [[Eph.6.5|Eph.6:5]], al.; pl., [[Mat.9.4|Mat.9:4]], [[Mrk.2.6|Mrk.2:6]], al.; opposite to στόμα, χείλεα, πρόσωπον, [[Mat.15.8|Mat.15:8]], [[Mrk.7.6|Mrk.7:6]], [[Rom.10.8|Rom.10:8]], 9 [[2Co.5.12|2Co.5:12]]; περιτομὴ καρδίας, [[Rom.2.29|Rom.2:29]] ἐκ κ., [[Rom.6.17|Rom.6:17]], [[1Pe.1.22|1Pe.1:22]]; ἀπὸ τῶν κ., [[Mat.18.35|Mat.18:35]] ἐν ὅλῃ (ἐξ ὅλης), [[Mat.22.37|Mat.22:37]], [[Mrk.12.30|Mrk.12:30]]" (LXX) ; γινώσκειν (ἐρευνᾶν, δοκιμάζειν) τὰς κ., [[Luk.16.15|Luk.16:15]], [[Rom.8.27|Rom.8:27]], [[1Th.2.4|1Th.2:4]]; to think, etc., ἐν τ. κ., [[Mat.9.4|Mat.9:4]], [[Mrk.2.6|Mrk.2:6]], [[Luk.12.45|Luk.12:45]], [[Rom.10.6|Rom.10:6]]; συνιέναι (νοεῖν) τῇ κ., [[Mat.13.15|Mat.13:15]], [[Jhn.12.40|Jhn.12:40]]; ἐπαχύνθη ἡ κ., [[Mat.13.15|Mat.13:15]] (LXX); πωροῦν τὴν κ., [[Jhn.12.40|Jhn.12:40]] κ. εὐθεῖα, [[Act.8.21|Act.8:21]] πονηρά, [[Heb.3.12|Heb.3:12]] ἀμετανόητος, [[Rom.2.5|Rom.2:5]] εἶναι (ἔχειν) ἐν τῇ κ., [[2Co.7.3|2Co.7:3]], [[Php.1.7|Php.1:7]]; ὀδύνη τῇ κ., [[Rom.9.2|Rom.9:2]]
3. **Of the central or innermost part of anything **(of the pith of wood, Arist.): τ. γῆς, [[Mat.12.40|Mat.12:40]] (Cremer, 343ff.).
(AS)

G2545.def:
**καίω **
[in LXX for בָּעַר, יָקַד, שָׂרַף, etc. ;]
1. **to kindle, light**: with accusative, λύχνον, [[Mat.5.15|Mat.5:15]] pass., **to be lighted, to burn**: ptcp., [[Luk.12.35|Luk.12:35]], [[Rev.4.5; 8.10; 19.20|Rev.4:5 8:10 19:20]]; πυρί [[Heb.12.18|Heb.12:18]], [[Rev.8.8; 21.8|Rev.8:8 21:8]]; metaphorically, [[Luk.24.32|Luk.24:32]], [[Jhn.5.35|Jhn.5:35]].
2. **to burn, destroy by fire**: pass., [[Jhn.15.6|Jhn.15:6]], [[1Co.13.3|1Co.13:3]].†
(AS)

G2503.def:
**ἰῶτα**, τό ,
**iota **(Heb. י, i.e. the smallest letter): [[Mat.5.18|Mat.5:18]]†
(AS)

G2549.def:
**κακία**, -ας, ἡ
(κακός), [in LXX chiefly for רָאָה ;]
1. badness in quality (opposite to ἀρετή, excellence).
2. **wickedness, depravity, malignity**: [[Act.8.22|Act.8:22]], [[Rom.1.29|Rom.1:29]], [[1Co.5.8; 14.20|1Co.5:8 14:20]], [[Eph.4.31|Eph.4:31]], [[Col.3.8|Col.3:8]], [[Tit.3.3|Tit.3:3]], [[Jas.1.21|Jas.1:21]], [[1Pe.2.1; 2.16|1Pe.2:1 2:16]].
3. In late Gk., evil, trouble, affliction ([[Amo.3.6|Amo.3:6]], [[1Sa.6.9|1Ki.6:9]], [[Ecc.7.15|Ecc.7:15]], [[Sir.19.6|Sir.19:6]], al.): [[Mat.6.34|Mat.6:34]] (cf. MM, _Exp._, xv).†
_SYN._: (πονηρία) (AS)

G2595.def:
**κάρφος**, -εος (-ους) τό
[in LXX: [[Gen.8.11|Gen.8:11]] (טָרַף) * ;]
**a small dry stalk, a twig**; metaphorically, of a minor fault: [[Mat.7.3-5|Mat.7:3-5]], [[Luk.6.41-42|Luk.6:41-42]].†
(AS)

G2511.def:
**καθαρίζω**
(Hellenistic-FlJ, Inscr.-for Attic καθαίρω, which see, on the vulgar -ερ-, [[Mat.8.3|Mat.8:3]], [[Mrk.1.42|Mrk.1:42]], see Bl., § 6, 1; Thackeray, _Gr._, 74) [in LXX chiefly for טָהֵר ;]
to cleanse, make clean.
1. **In physical sense**: with accusative of thing(s), figuratively, [[Mat.23.25-26|Mat.23:25-26]], [[Luk.11.39|Luk.11:39]]; of disease (leprosy), with accusative of person(s), [[Mat.8.2-3; 10.8; 11.5|Mat.8:2-3 10:8 11:5]], [[Mrk.1.40-42|Mrk.1:40-42]] [[Luk.4.27; 5.12-13; 7.22; 17.14, 17|Luk.4:27 5:12-13 7:22 17:14, 17]]; ἡ λέπρα ἐκαθερίσθη (on the spelling see supr.), [[Mat.8.3|Mat.8:3]]
2. **In ethical sense**: τ. καρδίας, [[Act.15.9|Act.15:9]] (cf. [[Sir.38.10|Sir.38:10]]); τ. χεῖρας, [[Jas.4.8|Jas.4:8]] λαὸν ἑαυτῷ, [[Tit.2.14|Tit.2:14]] τ. ἐκκλησίαν, [[Eph.5.26|Eph.5:26]] with accusative of person(s) (of thing(s)), before ἀπό (131., § 36, 9; Deiss., BS, 216 f.), [[2Co.7.1|2Co.7:1]], [[Heb.9.14|Heb.9:14]], [[1Jn.1.7|1Jn.1:7]] [[Jhn.1.9|Jn 1:9]].
3. **In ceremonial sense**: [[Mrk.7.19|Mrk.7:19]], [[Act.10.15; 11.9|Act.10:15 11:9]], [[Heb.9.22-23; 10.2|Heb.9:22-23 10:2]] (cf. δια-καθαρίζω).†
(AS)

G2572.def:
**καλύπτω **
[in LXX almost always for כָּסָה pi. ;]
in cl., rare in prose,
**to cover**: with accusative of person(s), [[Luk.23.30|Luk.23:30]] with accusative of thing(s) and dative, [[Luk.8.16|Luk.8:16]] pass., [[Mat.8.24|Mat.8:24]] metaphorically, **to veil, conceal**: pf. ptcp. pass., [[Mat.10.26|Mat.10:26]], [[2Co.4.3|2Co.4:3]]; of the forgiveness of sins (cf. [[Psa.32.5; 85.2|Psa.32:5 85:2]]; _DB_, ii, 56b): [[1Pe.4.8|1Pe.4:8]], [[Jas.5.20|Jas.5:20]]; (seel. for καιομένη, WH, mg., [[Luk.24.32|Luk.24:32]]).†
(AS)

G2540.def:
**καιρός**, -οῦ, ὁ
[in LXX chiefly for עֵת, also for מוֹעֵד, etc. ;]
1. due measure, fitness, proportion (Eur., Xen., al.).
2. Of Time (cl. also) in the sense of a fixed and definite period, **time, season **(Kennedy, _Sources_, 153): [[Mat.11.25|Mat.11:25]], [[Mrk.1.15|Mrk.1:15]], [[Luk.21.8|Luk.21:8]], [[Rom.13.11|Rom.13:11]], [[Eph.6.18|Eph.6:18]], [[Heb.11.15|Heb.11:15]], [[1Pe.1.5; 1.11|1Pe.1:5 1:11]] [[Rev.1.3|Rev.1:3]], al.; with genitive, πειρασμοῦ [[Luk.8.13|Luk.8:13]] τ. καρπῶν, [[Mat.21.34|Mat.21:34]] σύκων, [[Mrk.11.13|Mrk.11:13]] pl., [[Mat.21.41|Mat.21:41]] χρόνοι ἢ (καὶ) κ., [[Act.1.7|Act.1:7]], [[1Th.5.1|1Th.5:1]]; ἐθνῶν, [[Luk.21.24|Luk.21:24]] of opportune or seasonable time, [[Act.24.25|Act.24:25]], [[Gal.6.10|Gal.6:10]], [[Eph.5.16|Eph.5:16]], [[Col.4.5|Col.4:5]]; with inf., [[Heb.11.15|Heb.11:15]] ὁ κ. οὗτος, [[Mrk.10.30|Mrk.10:30]], [[Luk.18.30|Luk.18:30]]; ὁ νῦν κ. (Dalman, _Words_, 148), [[Rom.8.18|Rom.8:18]] ὁ κ. ὁ ἐμός, [[Jhn.7.6|Jhn.7:6]] κ. δεκτῲ, [[2Co.6.2|2Co.6:2]] (LXX); δουλεύειν τῷ κ., [[Rom.12.11|Rom.12:11]], R, mg.; τ. σημεῖα τῶν κ., [[Mat.16.3|Mat.16:3]] adverbial usages: ἐν κ., [[Mat.24.45|Mat.24:45]], [[1Pe.5.6|1Pe.5:6]] (cf. καιρῷ, [[Luk.20.10|Luk.20:10]] τῷ κ., [[Mrk.12.2|Mrk.12:2]]); ἄχρι καιροῦ, [[Luk.4.13|Luk.4:13]] πρὸς καιρόν, [[Luk.8.13|Luk.8:13]], [[1Co.7.5|1Co.7:5]]; κατὰ καιρόν, [[Rom.5.6|Rom.5:6]] πρὸ καιροῦ, [[Mat.8.29|Mat.8:29]]
_SYN._: (χρόνος) time in the sense of duration (AS)

G2537.def:
**καινός**, -ή, -όν
[in LXX ([[Ezk.11.19|Eze.11:19]], al.) for חָדָשׁ, exc. [[Isa.65.15|Isa.65:15]] (אַחֵר) ;]
**of that which is unused or unaccustomed, new in respect to form or quality, fresh, unused, novel**: opposite to παλαιός, ἀρχαῖος, [[Mat.9.17; 13.52|Mat.9:17 13:52]], [[Mrk.2.21-22|Mrk.2:21-22]] [[Luk.5.36, 38|Luk.5:36, 38]], [[2Co.5.17|2Co.5:17]], [[Eph.4.24|Eph.4:24]]; πλήρωμα, [[Mrk.2.21|Mrk.2:21]] μνημεῖον, [[Mat.27.60|Mat.27:60]], [[Jhn.19.41|Jhn.19:41]]; διαθήκη (T, WH, R, txt., omit), [[Luk.22.20|Luk.22:20]], [[1Co.11.25|1Co.11:25]], [[2Co.3.6|2Co.3:6]], [[Heb.8.8|Heb.8:8]]" (LXX), [[Heb.8.13; 9.15|Heb.8:13 9:15]]; οὐρανοί, γῆ, [[2Pe.3.13|2Pe.3:13]], [[Rev.21.1|Rev.21:1]]" (LXX) Ἰερουσαλήμ, [[Rev.3.12; 21.2|Rev.3:12 21:2]]; ἄνθρωπος, [[Eph.2.15|Eph.2:15]] (cf. [[Ezk.18.31|Eze.18:31]]); πάντα, [[Rev.21.5|Rev.21:5]] γέννημα τ. ἀμπέλου, [[Mat.26.29|Mat.26:29]], [[Mrk.14.25|Mrk.14:25]]; διδαχή, [[Mrk.1.27|Mrk.1:27]], [[Act.17.19|Act.17:19]]; ἐντολή, [[Jhn.13.34|Jhn.13:34]], [[1Jn.2.7-8|1Jn.2:7-8]], [[2Jn.5|2Jn.5]]; ὄνομα, [[Rev.2.17|Rev.2:17]] (LXX); ᾠδή, [[Rev.5.9; 14.3|Rev.5:9 14:3]] (of. [[Psa.144.9|Psa.144:9]]); κτίσις, [[2Co.5.17|2Co.5:17]], [[Gal.6.15|Gal.6:15]]; γλῶσσαι, [[Mrk.16.17|Mrk.16:17]] compar., [[Act.17.21|Act.17:21]]†
_SYN._: νέος, "the new primarily in reference to time, the young, recent; κ. . the new primarily in reference to quality, the fresh, unworn". Cf. Tr., _Syn._, § lx (the distinction, however, is less marked in late Gk.; cf. [[Heb.12.24|Heb.12:24]] with He, ll. with supr., and see MM, _Exp._, xv) (AS)

G2581.def:
**Καναναῖος**, -ου, ὁ
(late _Heb._ קָנָא),
**a Cananæan or Zealot **(cf. ζηλωτής): [[Mat.10.4|Mat.10:4]], [[Mrk.3.18|Mrk.3:18]] (Rec. -νίτης).†
(AS)

G2573.def:
**καλῶς **
_adv._ (καλός), [in LXX for parts and derivatives of יָטַב ;]
**finely, rightly, well**: [[Luk.6.48|Luk.6:48]], [[1Co.14.17|1Co.14:17]], [[Gal.4.17; 5.7|Gal.4:17 5:7]], [[Jas.2.3|Jas.2:3]]; λέγειν, λαλεῖν, etc., [[Mat.15.7|Mat.15:7]], [[Mrk.7.6; 12.28|Mrk.7:6 12:28]], [[Luk.6.26; 20.39|Luk.6:26 20:39]], [[Jhn.4.17; 8.48; 13.13; 18.23|Jhn.4:17 8:48 13:13 18:23]], [[Act.28.25|Act.28:25]]; as exclamation of approval, [[Mrk.12.32|Mrk.12:32]], [[Rom.11.20|Rom.11:20]]; κ. ποιεῖν, [[Mat.12.12|Mat.12:12]], [[1Co.7.37-38|1Co.7:37-38]] [[Jas.2.8, 19|Jas.2:8, 19]]; with dative of person(s) (cl. accusative; WM, § 32, 1 β), [[Luk.6.27|Luk.6:27]] with accusative of thing(s), [[Mrk.7.37|Mrk.7:37]] with ptcp., [[Act.10.33|Act.10:33]] (M, _Pr._, 131), [[Php.4.14|Php.4:14]], [[2Pe.1.19|2Pe.1:19]], [[3Jn.6|3Jn.6]]; προϊστάναι (-ασθαι), [[1Ti.3.4; 3.12; 5.17|1Ti.3:4 3:12 5:17]]; διακονεῖν, [[1Ti.3.13|1Ti.3:13]] ἀνατρέφεσθαι, [[Heb.13.18|Heb.13:18]] ironically, [[Mrk.7.9|Mrk.7:9]], [[2Co.11.4|2Co.11:4]] (but see CGT, in l); κ. ἔχειν, **to be well**: [[Mrk.16.18|Mrk.16:18]] Compar., κάλλιον (for superl., B1., § 44, 3), **very well**: [[Act.25.10|Act.25:10]]†
(AS)

G2576.def:
**καμμύω**
(syncopated form of καταμύω, used by Ep. and κοινή writers; Rutherford, _NPhr._, 426 f.) [in LXX: [[Isa.6.10|Isa.6:10]] (שָׁעַע hi.) [[Isa.29.10; 33.15|Isa.29:10 33:15]] (עָצַם), [[Lam.3.44|La 3:44]] AR* ;]
**to shut the eyes**: τ. ὀφθαλμούς, [[Mat.13.15|Mat.13:15]], [[Act.28.27|Act.28:27]] (Isa, l.with).†
(AS)

G2592.def:
**καρπο-φορέω**, -ῶ
[in LXX: [[Hab.3.17|Hab.3:17]] (פָּרַח), [[Wis.10.7|Wis.10:7]] * ;]
**to bear fruit**: χόρτον, [[Mrk.4.28|Mrk.4:28]] (cf. Wis, l.with). Metaphorical, of conduct: [[Mat.13.23|Mat.13:23]], [[Mrk.4.20|Mrk.4:20]], [[Luk.8.15|Luk.8:15]], [[Rom.7.4-5|Rom.7:4-5]], [[Col.1.10|Col.1:10]]; mid., [[Col.1.6|Col.1:6]]†
(AS)

G2551.def:
**κακολογέω**, -ῶ
(κακολόγος, slanderous), [in LXX: [[Exo.21.16; 22.28|Exo.21:16 22:28]], [[1Sa.3.13|1Ki.3:13]], [[Pro.20.20|Pro.20:20]], [[Ezk.22.7|Eze.22:7]] (קָלַל pi., hi.), [[2Ma.4.1|2Ma.4:1]] * ;]
**to speak ill of, revile, abuse**: with accusative of person(s), [[Mat.15.4|Mat.15:4]], [[Mrk.7.10|Mrk.7:10]]" (LXX) [[Mrk.9.39|Mrk.9:39]] with accusative of thing(s), [[Act.19.9|Act.19:9]]†
(AS)

G2531.def:
**καθώς**, (i.e. καθ᾽ ὡς), Hellenistic for καθά, which see, καθάπερ, καθό, καθότι (Mayser, 485; Eutherford, _NPhr._, 495; Bl., §78, 1),
**according as, even as, just as, as**: [[Luk.1.2|Luk.1:2]] (see: καθά), 24:39, [[Jhn.5.23|Jhn.5:23]], [[Act.7.48|Act.7:48]], [[1Co.8.2|1Co.8:2]], [[Gal.3.6|Gal.3:6]], al.; before οὕτως, [[Luk.11.30|Luk.11:30]], [[Jhn.3.14|Jhn.3:14]], [[2Co.1.5|2Co.1:5]], [[Col.3.13|Col.3:13]], [[1Jn.2.6|1Jn.2:6]], al.; before καί, [[Jhn.15.9|Jhn.15:9]], [[1Co.15.49|1Co.15:49]], [[1Jn.2.18|1Jn.2:18]], al.; οὕτως . . . κ., [[Luk.24.24|Luk.24:24]] id. with ellipsis of οὕτως, [[Mat.21.6|Mat.21:6]], [[Mrk.16.7|Mrk.16:7]], [[Rom.1.13|Rom.1:13]], al.; with other elliptical constructions, [[Jhn.6.58; 17.21, 22|Jhn.6:58 17:21, 22]] [[Act.15.8|Act.15:8]], [[1Th.2.13|1Th.2:13]], [[1Ti.1.3|1Ti.1:3]], [[1Jn.3.2, 3, 12|1Jn.3:2, 3 12]]; καθὼς γέγραπται (Deiss., _BS_, 249), [[Mat.26.24|Mat.26:24]], [[Mrk.9.13|Mrk.9:13]], [[Rom.1.17|Rom.1:17]], al.; introducing subst. clause as object of verb (as in Heb.), [[Mat.21.6|Mat.21:6]], [[Mrk.11.6|Mrk.11:6]], [[Luk.5.14|Luk.5:14]], al.; after verbs of speaking, [[Act.15.14|Act.15:14]] of proportion and degree, [[Mrk.4.33|Mrk.4:33]], [[1Co.12.11, 18|1Co.12:11, 18]] al.; of time ([[Neh.5.6|Neh.5:6]], [[2Ma.1.31|2Ma.1:31]]), [[Act.7.17|Act.7:17]].
(AS)

G2515.def:
**καθ-έδρα**, -ας, ἡ
(κατά, + ἔδρα, a seat) [in LXX for מוֹשָׁב and cogn. forms ;]
**a chair, seat**: [[Mat.21.12|Mat.21:12]], [[Mrk.11.16|Mrk.11:16]]; of teachers, [[Mat.23.2|Mat.23:2]]†
(AS)

G2519.def:
**καθηγητής**, -οῦ, ὁ
(καθηγέομαι, to go before, guide),
1. prop., a guide.
2. **a master, teacher **(M_Gr._ professor): [[Mat.23.16|Mat.23:16]]†
(AS)

G2525.def:
**καθ-ίστημι**
(and καθιστάνω, [[Act.17.15|Act.17:15]]), [in LXX for פָּקַד, קוּם, שׂוּם, etc., 24 words in all* ;]
1.
(a) **to set down**;
(b) **to bring down to a place** (Hom., Xen., al.; [[2Ch.28.15|2Ch.28:15]], [[1Sa.5.3|1Ki.5:3]]): [[Act.17.15|Act.17:15]].
2. **to set in order, appoint, make, constitute**: [[Tit.1.5|Tit.1:5]], [[2Pe.1.8|2Pe.1:8]]; with dupl. accusative, κριτήν, [[Luk.12.14|Luk.12:14]] ἡγούμενον, [[Act.7.10|Act.7:10]] ἄρχοντα, [[Act.7.27, 35|Act.7:27, 35]]" (LXX) ; ἀρχιερεῖς, [[Heb.7.28|Heb.7:28]] before ἐπί, with genitive, [[Mat.24.45; 25.21, 23|Mat.24:45 25:21, 23]], [[Luk.12.42|Luk.12:42]], [[Act.6.3|Act.6:3]]; id. with dative, [[Mat.24.47|Mat.24:47]], [[Luk.12.44|Luk.12:44]]; id. with accusative, [[Heb.2.7|Heb.2:7]] (LXX) (WH, R, mg. omit); pass. (see Mayor, _Ja._, 115 f.), [[Rom.5.19|Rom.5:19]], [[Jas.3.6; 4.4|Jas.3:6 4:4]]; before εἰς with inf., [[Heb.8.3|Heb.8:3]] τὰ πρὸς τ. θεόν, [[Heb.5.1|Heb.5:1]] (cf. ἀντι-, ἀπο-καθίστημι).
† (AS)

G2533.def:
**Καιάφας** (T, Καϊ-), -α ὁ,
**Caiaphas **(on the name, see _Exp._ Times, x, 185): [[Mat.26.3, 57|Mat.26:3, 57]], [[Luk.3.2|Luk.3:2]], [[Jhn.11.4; 18.13-14, 24; 18.28|Jhn.11:4 18:13-14, 24 18:28]] [[Act.4.6|Act.4:6]].†
Καΐφας, for Καιάφας, which see: [[Luk.3.2|Luk.3:2]] (L)
(AS)

G2516.def:
**καθ-έζομαι **
[in LXX: [[Lev.12.5|Lev.12:5]], al. (יָשַׁב), [[Job.39.28|Job.39:28]] (שָׁכַן) ;]
**to sit down, sit**: [[Jhn.20.12|Jhn.20:12]] before ἐν, [[Mat.26.55|Mat.26:55]], [[Luk.2.46|Luk.2:46]], [[Jhn.11.20|Jhn.11:20]], [[Act.6.15|Act.6:15]]; before ἐπί, with genitive, [[Act.20.9|Act.20:9]] id. with dative, [[Jhn.4.6|Jhn.4:6]] (cf. παρα-καθέζ-, κάθημαι).†
καθ ̓ εἷς, see: (εἷς.)
(AS)

G2512.def:
**καθαρισμός**, -oῦ, τό
(καθαρίζω). [in LXX for טָהֵר, טׇהֳרָה, etc. ;]
**cleansing, purification**: [[Jhn.3.25|Jhn.3:25]] with genitive subjc., τ. Ἰουδαίων, [[Jhn.2.6|Jhn.2:6]] with genitive obj., of women after childbirth, [[Luk.2.22|Luk.2:22]] of lepers, [[Mrk.1.44|Mrk.1:44]], [[Luk.5.14|Luk.5:14]]; with genitive of thing(s), τ. ἁμαρτιῶν, [[Heb.1.3|Heb.1:3]], [[2Pe.1.9|2Pe.1:9]] (Cremer, 319).†
(AS)

G2554.def:
**κακο-ποιέω**, ῶ
[in LXX chiefly for רָעַע hi. ;]
**to do harm, to do evil**: [[Mrk.3.4|Mrk.3:4]], [[Luk.6.9|Luk.6:9]], [[1Pe.3.17|1Pe.3:17]], [[3Jn.11|3Jn.11]] (Cremer, 329).†
(AS)

G2500.def:
**Ἰωσῆς**, -ῆ (Rec. -ή [[Luk.3.29|Luk.3:29]] AV, Jose; see: Ἰησοῦς, 3), and -ῆτος (Mk, ll with), ὁ,
**Joses**;
1. **brother of our Lord**: [[Mrk.6.3|Mrk.6:3]], [[Mat.13.55|Mat.13:55]] (Rec., see: Ἰωσήφ).
2. **Son of Mary**: [[Mat.27.56|Mat.27:56]] (-σήφ), WH, txt), [[Mrk.15.40, 47|Mrk.15:40, 47]]
3. see: Βαρνάβας.†
(AS)

G2507.def:
**καθ-αιρέω**, -ῶ
[in LXX for נָתַץ, פָּרַץ, יָרַד, etc. ;]
1. **to take down**: with accusative of person(s) (the technical term for removal after crucifixion, Field, _Notes_, 44), [[Mrk.15.36, 46|Mrk.15:36, 46]], [[Luk.23.53|Luk.23:53]], [[Act.13.29|Act.13:29]].
2. **to put down by force, pull down, destroy**: ἀποθήκας, [[Luk.12.18|Luk.12:18]] (opposite to οἰκοδομεῖν); δυνάστας, [[Luk.1.52|Luk.1:52]] ἔθνη, [[Act.13.19|Act.13:19]] pass., [[Act.19.27|Act.19:27]] (diminished, Field, _Notes_, 129 f.); figuratively, **to refute**: λογισμούς, [[2Co.10.5|2Co.10:5]]†
(AS)

G2517.def:
**καθ-εξῆς**
(= cl. ἑξῆς, ἐφεξῆς)
_adv._,
1. **successively, in order**: [[Luk.1.3|Luk.1:3]], [[Act.11.4; 18.23|Act.11:4 18:23]]; τῶν κ.. (those that succeeded him), [[Act.3.24|Act.3:24]]
2. **after­wards**: ἐν τῷ κ. (sc. χρόνῳ), [[Luk.8.1|Luk.8:1]]†
(AS)

G2536.def:
**Καινάμ** (T, Καϊ-; Rec. Καϊνάν), ό, indecl. (Heb. קֵינָן),
**Cainam, Cainan**;
1. son of Enos ([[Gen.5.9|Gen.5:9]]): [[Luk.3.37|Luk.3:37]].
2. Son of Arphaxad ([[Gen.10.24|Gen.10:24]] (LXX): [[Luk.3.36|Luk.3:36]]†
(AS)

G2524.def:
**καθ-ίημι **
[in LXX: [[Exo.17.11|Exo.17:11]] (נוּחַ hi.), and seel., [[1Ch.21.27|1Ch.21:27]], [[Zec.11.13|Zec.11:13]], [[Jer.32.14|Jer.32:14]] * ;]
**to send or let down**: before εἰς, [[Luk.5.19|Luk.5:19]] διά, with genitive, ib., [[Act.9.25|Act.9:25]] ptcp., before ἐπί, with genitive, [[Act.10.11|Act.10:11]] ἐκ, [[Act.11.5|Act.11:5]]†
(AS)

G2508.def:
**καθαίρω**
(καθαρός), [in LXX: [[Isa.28.27|Isa.28:27]] (דּוּשׁ ho.), [[2Ki.4.6|2Ki.4:6]], [[Jer.51.39|Jer.51:39]] א* ;]
**to cleanse**: of pruning, [[Jhn.15.2|Jhn.15:2]] (cf. καθαρίζω).†
(AS)

G2587.def:
**Καππαδοκία**, -ας, ἡ
**Cappadocia, a province of Asia Minor**: [[Act.2.9|Act.2:9]], [[1Pe.1.1|1Pe.1:1]].†
(AS)

G2527.def:
**καθόλου**
(= καθ᾽ ὅλον and so in cl. bef. Arist.)
_adv._, [in LXX: [[Exo.22.11|Exo.22:11]](10) [[Amo.3.3-4;|Amo.3:3-4]] [[Ezk.13.3, 22; 17.14|Eze.13:3, 22 17:14]] (τὸ κ, μή = בִּלְתִּי), Dan LXX TH [[Dan.3.50|Dan.3:50]]* ;]
**on the whole, in general**: μή κ., not at all, [[Act.4.18|Act.4:18]]†
(AS)

G2559.def:
**κακόω**, -ῶ
(κακός), [in LXX chiefly for רָעַע hi., עָנָה pi. ;]
1. **to ill-treat, afflict, distress**: with accusative of person(s), [[Act.7.6, 19; 12.1; 18.10|Act.7:6, 19 12:1 18:10]], [[1Pe.3.13|1Pe.3:13]].
2. (not in cl.), to embitter ([[Psa.106.32|Psa.106:32]]): [[Act.14.2|Act.14:2]],†
(AS)

G2561.def:
**κάκωσις**, -εως, ἡ
(κακόω) [Ín LXX (for עָנִי, יָדַע, etc.): [[Exo.3.7|Exo.3:7]], [[Jer.2.28|Jer.2:28]], [[Wis.3.2|Wis.3:2]], al. ;]
**ill-treatment**: [[Act.7.34|Act.7:34]] (LXX),†
(AS)

G2520.def:
**καθ-ήκω **
[in LXX: impers., [[Lev.5.16|Lev.5:16]], [[Ezk.21.27|Eze.21:27]] (32), al. (מִשְׁפָּט); τὰ κ., [[Exo.5.13|Exo.5:13]], al. (דָבַר), etc. ;]
1. to come down, come to.
2. **to be fit, proper**: impers., with accusative and inf., [[Act.22.22|Act.22:22]] (on the tense, see Bl., § 63, 4); τὰ μὴ καθήκοντα, [[Rom.1.28|Rom.1:28]]†
(AS)

G2566.def:
**καλλίων**, -ον
compar. of καλός, see: καλῶς
**καλῶς **
_adv._ (καλός), [in LXX for parts and derivatives of יָטַב ;]
**finely, rightly, well**: [[Luk.6.48|Luk.6:48]], [[1Co.14.17|1Co.14:17]], [[Gal.4.17; 5.7|Gal.4:17 5:7]], [[Jas.2.3|Jas.2:3]]; λέγειν, λαλεῖν, etc., [[Mat.15.7|Mat.15:7]], [[Mrk.7.6; 12.28|Mrk.7:6 12:28]], [[Luk.6.26; 20.39|Luk.6:26 20:39]], [[Jhn.4.17; 8.48; 13.13; 18.23|Jhn.4:17 8:48 13:13 18:23]], [[Act.28.25|Act.28:25]]; as exclamation of approval, [[Mrk.12.32|Mrk.12:32]], [[Rom.11.20|Rom.11:20]]; κ. ποιεῖν, [[Mat.12.12|Mat.12:12]], [[1Co.7.37-38|1Co.7:37-38]] [[Jas.2.8, 19|Jas.2:8, 19]]; with dative of person(s) (cl. accusative; WM, § 32, 1 β), [[Luk.6.27|Luk.6:27]] with accusative of thing(s), [[Mrk.7.37|Mrk.7:37]] with ptcp., [[Act.10.33|Act.10:33]] (M, _Pr._, 131), [[Php.4.14|Php.4:14]], [[2Pe.1.19|2Pe.1:19]], [[3Jn.6|3Jn.6]]; προϊστάναι (-ασθαι), [[1Ti.3.4; 3.12; 5.17|1Ti.3:4 3:12 5:17]]; διακονεῖν, [[1Ti.3.13|1Ti.3:13]] ἀνατρέφεσθαι, [[Heb.13.18|Heb.13:18]] ironically, [[Mrk.7.9|Mrk.7:9]], [[2Co.11.4|2Co.11:4]] (but see CGT, in l); κ. ἔχειν, **to be well**: [[Mrk.16.18|Mrk.16:18]] Compar., κάλλιον (for superl., B1., § 44, 3), **very well**: [[Act.25.10|Act.25:10]]†
(AS)

G2510.def:
**καθ-άπτω **
[in Sm.: [[Sng.1.6|Sng.1:6]] * ;]
1. to fasten on, put upon, with accusative
2. Act. for mid. (cf. Bl., § 53, 3), **to lay hold of, attack**: with genitive, χειρός, [[Act.28.3|Act.28:3]]†
(AS)

G2538.def:
**καινότης**, -ητος, ἡ
(καινός), [in LXX: [[3Ki.8.53|3Ki.8:53]], [[Ezk.47.12|Eze.47:12]] * ;]
1. novelty (Thuc., Isocr., LS, see word).
2. **freshness, newness**: ἐν κ. ζωῆς (see Lft., _Notes_, 296), [[Rom.6.4|Rom.6:4]] ἐν κ. πνεύματος, [[Rom.7.6|Rom.7:6]]†
(AS)

G2578.def:
**κάμπτω **
[in LXX chiefly for כָּרַע, [[4Ki.1.13|4Ki.1:13]], [[2Ch.29.29|2Ch.29:29]], [[Isa.45.24|Isa.45:24]] (23), al. ;]
**to bend, bow**: with accusative of thing(s), γόνυ, τὰ γ.; with dative of person(s), τῇ Βάαλ, [[Rom.11.4|Rom.11:4]] (LXX); πρὸς τ. πατέρα, [[Eph.3.14|Eph.3:14]] by meton., πᾶν γόνυ for πᾶς, [[Rom.14.11|Rom.14:11]] (LXX) [[Php.2.10|Php.2:10]] (cf. ἀνα-, συν-κάμπτω).†
(AS)

G2565.def:
**καλλιέλαιος**, ου, ἡ
**the garden olive **(opposite to ἀγριέλ-): [[Rom.11.24|Rom.11:24]]†
(AS)

G2562.def:
**καλάμη**, -ης, ἡ
(cf. κάλαμος), [in LXX chiefly for קַשׁ, [[Exo.5.12|Exo.5:12]], [[Isa.5.24|Isa.5:24]], al. ;]
**a stalk of corn, stubble**: [[1Co.3.12|1Co.3:12]]†
(AS)

G2585.def:
**καπηλεύω**
(κάπηλος, a huckster, cf. [[Isa.1.22|Isa.1:22]] (LXX), [[Sir.26.29|Sir.26:29]])
to make a trade of (RV, mg., make merchandise of), or perhaps (cf. Isa, l.with) to corrupt (RV, tit.): [[2Co.2.17|2Co.2:17]]†
(AS)

G2571.def:
**κάλυμμα**, -τος, τό
(καλύπτω), [in LXX: [[Num.3.25; 4.8|Num.3:25 4:8]] ff. (מְכַסֶּה), Exo_34:33 ff. (מַסְוֶה), etc. ;]
**a covering, veil**: [[2Co.3.13-16|2Co.3:13-16]] †
(AS)

G2598.def:
**κατα-βάλλω **
[in LXX chiefly for נָפַל hi. ;]
1. **to cast down, prostrate**: metaphorically, pass., [[2Co.4.9|2Co.4:9]]
2. **to put down, lay down**: metaphorically, mid., with accusative, θεμέλιον, [[Heb.6.1|Heb.6:1]]†
(AS)

G2506.def:
**καθ-αίρεσις**, -εως, ἡ
(καθαιρέω), [in LXX: [[Exo.23.24|Exo.23:24]] (הָרַס), [[1Ma.3.43|1Ma.3:43]] * ;]
**a pulling down, destruction**: figuratively, κ. ὀχυρωμάτων, [[2Co.10.4|2Co.10:4]] opposite to οἰκοδομή, [[2Co.10.8; 13.10|2Co.10:8 13:10]].†
(AS)

G2583.def:
**κανών**, -όνος, ὁ
(cf. κάννα, and _Heb._ קָנֶה, a reed), [in LXX: [[Mic.7.4|Mic.7:4]], [[Jdt.13.6|Jdth.13:6]], [[4Ma.7.21|4Ma.7:21]] (and in Aq., [[Psa.19.5|Psa.19:5]], [[Job.38.5|Job.38:5]])* ;]
1. a rod or bar (Jth, l.with).
2. **a measuring rule**; hence, metaph,
3. **a rule or standard**: [[Gal.6.16|Gal.6:16]]
4. **a limit **(RV, province): [[2Co.10.13-16|2Co.10:13-16]] (For the history of the word and esp. its later meanings, see Westc., Canon, _App._ A; cf. also MM, _Exp._, xv; Cremer, 744.)†
(AS)

G2599.def:
**κατα-βαρέω**, -ῶ
**to weigh down**: metaphorically, with accusative of person(s), [[2Co.12.16|2Co.12:16]]†
(AS)

G2569.def:
**καλο-ποιέω**, -ῶ
[in LXX: [[Lev.5.4|Lev.5:4]] F (καλῶς π., B) * ;]
**to do well, act honourably**: [[2Th.3.13|2Th.3:13]] (cf. [[Gal.6.9|Gal.6:9]] τὸ καλὸν π.).†
(AS)

G2567.def:
**καλο-διδάσκαλος**, -ου, ὁ
**a teacher of that which is good**: [[Tit.2.3|Tit.2:3]]†
(AS)

G2535.def:
**Καίν**
(Τ, Κάϊν), ὁ,
indecl.
(in FlJ, Κάϊς, -ιος), (Heb. קַיִן; [[Gen.4.1|Gen.4:1]]),
**Cain**: [[Heb.11.4|Heb.11:4]], [[1Jn.3.12|1Jn.3:12]], [[Jude.11|Ju 11]].†
(AS)

G2558.def:
**κακουχέω**, -ῶ
(κακόν, ἔχω), [in LXX: [[3Ki.2.26 11:39|3Ki.2:26 11:39]] (עָנָה pi., hith.)* ;]
**to ill-treat, hurt, torment**: pass. ptcp., [[Heb.11.37; 13.3|Heb.11:37 13:3]].†
(AS)

G2577.def:
**κάμνω **
[in LXX: [[Job.10.1|Job.10:1]] (קוּט ni.) [[Job.17.2|Job.17:2]], [[Wis.4.16; 15.9|Wis.4:16 15:9]], [[4Ma.3.8|4Ma.3:8]] [[4Mac.7.13|4Mac 7:13]] * ;]
1. **to work**; hence, from the effect of continued work,
2. **to be weary**: [[Heb.12.3|Heb.12:3]]
3. **to be sick**: [[Jas.5.15|Jas.5:15]]†
(AS)

G2555.def:
**κακοποιός**, -όν
(κακόν, ποιέω), [in LXX: [[Pro.12.4|Pro.12:4]] (בּוּשׁ hi.) [[Pro.24.19|Pro.24:19]] (רָעַע hi.)* ;]
**doing evil**; as susbt., **an evil-doer**: [[1Pe.2.12; 2.14; 4.15|1Pe.2:12 2:14 4:15]].†
(AS)
